rationale: Isolate fault on l23 by opening it. Open l34 to prevent mesh when closing tie_24. Close tie_24 to restore b4 (priority 2, 40kW) from b2 side, achieving radial topology with b2 and b4 energized (total priority 5, total load 90kW). b3 cannot be restored as it is on the faulted side of l23 with no alternative feed.
